Every frame of a live exhibition match downloads 24-25 64x128 swizzled R5G6B5 render targets that #59's guard refuses (cvt), and the stadium fly-over behind the PRESS START banner 47-48: each a SURFACE_DOWN finish and a fence wait on the PFIFO thread (phase Fin 12.2-12.6 ms of a 27.3-27.7 ms play frame; 23.3-23.6 of 44.8-46.8 in the fly-over). Predicted, on runs against off runs: R, play median sd 1 a frame or less and cvt 0 (off 15 or more); P, play median G down 4-13 ms, point -8 (27.5 to ~19.5 ms: the PFIFO thread's frame without its finishes, floored at 16.7 by the vblank, plus whatever GPU time 25 decodes a frame add); F, play median gfps up 6 or more, point +14 (36 to ~50); I, fly-over (shot s20 to s23) median G down 10 ms or more, point -20 (46 to ~26).
